title: Austin's New Mayor and Team Sworn In
summary:
*   A special inauguration ceremony welcomed Austin's newly elected city leadership.
*   Texas Attorney General Dan Morales administered the oath of office to Mayor Bruce Todd and Councilmembers Ronney Reynolds, Gus Garcia, and Dr. Charles E. Urdy.
*   The council unanimously elected Dr. Charles E. Urdy as the new Mayor Pro Tem.
*   Newly sworn-in officials delivered brief inaugural speeches.
